messages:
mike.dev: Heads-up — canary publish to eu.gcr failed, deploybot halted. getting 'QuotaExceeded: namespace object count reached' when writing attestation. Repro log:
```
deploybot: push image gcr.io/redwood/canary/service:20240613-abc123 -> ATTACH_ATTESTATION failed: 403 QuotaExceeded: namespace blobs limit
```
Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: Automated: publish blocked for gcr.io/redwood/canary/service:20240613-abc123 — attestation rejected. Promotes paused.

sre_anne: How many images? Is this across all regions or just EU registry?

mike.dev: 6 images in eu canary (service, runtime, infra-agent, optimizer, docs-sidecar, tracing). Staging pushes OK (us-central). Looks like namespace-level quota (object count) hit on eu project.

registry-bot: quota snapshot: eu project 'redwood-prod-eu' object count: 50,001/50,000 — limit reached. last push 2024-06-13T14:05Z.

release_lead: Options? rollback to previous digest? retag and push to fallback registry? hold canary?

mike.dev: Could pin the canary to previous digest (sha256:prevabcd...) and continue smoke tests. But deploybot relies on attestation to allow promote; without attestation promote will stay blocked.

sre_anne: Two short-term paths: 1) Request quota bump (may take hours) 2) Retag+push to fallback namespace (eu-fallback) and re-run cosign attestation there. Do we have IAM/KMS access to attest in fallback?

mike.dev: We do have a fallback project but keys live in global KMS; cosign attestation should work. Command I'd run for retag push:
```
# copy and attest
gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/canary/service@sha256:abcd... gcr.io/redwood-eu-fallback/canary/service:20240613-abc123
cosign attest --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/cosign --predicate=predicate.json gcr.io/redwood-eu-fallback/canary/service:20240613-abc123
```

deploy-bot: I will block promotes until a manual override, or until attestation exists for the pushed image in the configured registry. Use `/deploy override-attestation <image>` to proceed (audit log kept).

release_lead: Let's hold canary promotion until either quota bump or fallback attestation is in place. Mike — can you try retag+attest to eu-fallback and report back? Anne — please queue a quota increase request with infra.

mike.dev: On it. I'll try retag+attest now and post results. If successful, we can record in release notes: 'Canary pushes temporarily routed to eu-fallback due to registry quota; provenance verified in fallback registry.'

sre_anne: Filed quota request (#INC-20240613-1) with registry team — ETA 6-12h. Added temporary routing to deploybot rules to prefer eu-fallback if primary attestation fails.

mike.dev: Retag+attest succeeded for 4/6 images, 2 failed with transient 429 from mirror. Rerun queued. Verified attestation presence with `gcloud container images describe` and `cosign verify-attestation`.

release_lead: OK — keep canary held. If all attests are green by EOD, we'll proceed with limited promote window at 18:00 UTC. Add note to changelog and callout in release channel.

mike.dev: Draft release note snippet:
- Canary publish delayed in EU due to registry namespace quota. Temporary routing to eu-fallback used for attestation. No production promotes performed. Follow-up: request quota increase and cleanup orphan blobs.

sre_anne: I'll also schedule cleanup script to prune old unreferenced blobs in eu project during change window.

mike.dev: Assigning tasks: mike.dev -> finish re-push + attestation; sre_anne -> quota request + cleanup; release_lead -> update release notes + hold promoter; deploy-bot -> keep blocks until manual clear. :white_check_mark:

release_lead: Thanks — please ping #releases when promote window is green.

mike.dev: Will do, posting updates in this thread. :raised_hands:
